validation.notes: DTU's own visual-identity guide (designguide.dtu.dk, a dtu.dk subdomain) publishes the downloadable primary corporate logo. Asset verified live: HTTP 200, Content-Type image/jpeg, 310x387 px, 37931 bytes, and visually confirmed to be the DTU primary corporate logo (crimson 'DTU' logotype above the three stylized lions described in DTU's brand hierarchy page: 'The logo-with the DTU logotype and the three stylized lions-always comes first'). The scholarship page itself (https://www.dtu.dk/english/education/graduate/fees-and-funding/tuition_fee_waivers) contains zero external image assets - the DTU mark is an inline <svg><symbol id="dtu-logo"> sprite, i.e. no fetchable URL there - which is why the official brand-asset page was used instead. Lowest-risk choice on the design guide is this red primary logo; the white/negative variant (dtu_logo_hvid.jpg) is invisible on light backgrounds and the 'sekundaer' variants are discouraged secondary colours, so those were rejected.

records.title: Arab Fund Fellowship for Academic Excellence (برنامج الزمالات للتميز الأكاديمي)

validation.notes: FETCH CAVEAT FOR THE INTEGRATOR: www.arabfund.org sits behind bot protection - plain HTTP GET returns 403 Forbidden for both the page and the image. The page and the asset were therefore rendered and measured in a real browser engine (HTTP 200, image naturalWidth 321 x naturalHeight 346). Identity confirmed visually: the image is the Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development emblem - the AFESD shield with the double-headed eagle and the Arabic legend 'الصندوق العربي للتنمية الاقتصادية والاجتماعية' - i.e. the Arabic name of the Arab Fund, exactly the awarding body named in the record. It is the site-wide brand mark, present in both the header and the footer of the record's own official fellowship page and of the homepage (no alt text, so identity rests on the rendered pixels plus page context). 'Logo-1ldpi' is WordPress's low-density export naming; the served file is 321x346 px, i.e. a full logo lockup rather than a favicon-sized badge. No higher-resolution variant is referenced anywhere on the domain, and /overview/media-center is HTTP 404, so no official brand/press asset page exists.

source.publisher: Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development (AFESD)
source.raw_extract: Rendered in a browser (HTTP 200, document.title "Fellowship for Academic Excellence - Arab Fund"). Page body text: "Since 1997, the Arab Fund's Fellowship Program has empowered the Arab world’s scholars in different fields of specialization who have excellent academic track record to conduct advanced research and/or academic activity at some of the world’s most prestigious universities." The same appears twice on the page (header and footer) at natural size 321x346.

validation.notes: The awarding body is Qatar University itself (the Scholarships Section sits inside the Office of the Vice President for Student Affairs), so the university's own primary logo is the correct mark. qulogo.png is the header brand mark of the official qu.edu.qa homepage: GET-verified HTTP 200, Content-Type image/png, 610x135 px, 9742 bytes, and visually confirmed to be the official Qatar University logo (Arabic 'جامعة قطر' over 'QATAR UNIVERSITY' beside the maroon geometric Q emblem). The Scholarship subsite itself uses a different file, /Style Library/Logos and Themes/Students/logo/Logo.png (290x136, a composite lockup reading 'Qatar University' + 'Student Affairs'); it is on the correct official domain but is a subordinate-unit lockup at lower resolution, so the university-wide primary mark was chosen instead. Both were inspected, not assumed.
